description: Roadmap-driven development backlog for the Iron God product rotation. Items come from each repository's docs/OWNER_APPROVED_ROADMAP_2026-10-25.md and code audit (2026-10-27). Only status=approved items whose level is within portfolio_rotation.development_level and that carry a build spec are dispatched to the local worker; everything else is a reviewed plan for a stronger implementer (Claude or the owner). Approval is the owner's decision.

levels.1: small new pure function in an existing package (the only level the local 7B worker has measured success at)
levels.2: existing-module change: modify functions, repair defects, improve validation, focused tests
levels.3: feature integration: connect existing components into working product functionality
levels.5: complex development: architecture, integration testing, several independently verified slices

items.title: Audit the import-to-export chain on one lawful real song
items.roadmap_ref: docs/OWNER_APPROVED_ROADMAP_2026-10-25.md next slice 1; PROJECT_PLAN.md Product Reality Gate v1
items.addresses: First usable product milestone: import a song, generate a playable arrangement, validate, export
items.why: The roadmap forbids claiming playability from synthetic checks; the first broken real-song seam decides every later fix.
items.consumer: RS-2 repairs the seam this audit identifies; the Product Reality report records it.
items.objective: Run one lawful development song through the packaged Windows import -> arrangement -> validation -> XML/PSARC export path, record each stage's outcome, and name the first stage whose output is wrong, missing or requires a CLI workaround.
acceptance_criteria: A Product Reality evidence record names the build, the song identity hash, every stage's result and the first broken seam with a reproducible command or UI path.
tests: None new: this is an evidence-gathering audit; RS-2 adds the regression test.
items.complexity: medium (needs the packaged app and a real song; human-assisted)
items.verification: Owner or Claude reviews the evidence record; no code change.
items.definition_of_done: The first broken seam is named with reproduction steps and filed as RS-2's concrete objective.

items.title: Repair the first broken real-song seam
items.addresses: The seam RS-1 identifies

items.objective: Fix the seam named by RS-1 with a regression test and provenance, without weakening validation or review gates.
acceptance_criteria: The RS-1 reproduction now succeeds; a regression test fails before and passes after the fix; the repository preflight passes.
tests: A regression test reproducing the RS-1 failure.
items.verification: Repository preflight plus re-running the RS-1 reproduction.
items.definition_of_done: Merged with CI green and the RS-1 path re-verified.

items.title: Generate and export real fret-hand-positions (anchors)
items.addresses: The XML export writes <anchors count="0"/> for every difficulty although EOF requires at least one per fretted track
items.why: Without anchors Rocksmith cannot position the fret hand, so exported arrangements are not properly playable in game.
items.consumer: rocksmith_xml export of every Bass/Lead/Rhythm arrangement.
items.objective: Port EOF's default geometric fret-hand-position rule (the tolerance rule item 14 already audits) into the export so each fretted track gets real anchors, keeping the existing tolerance check as the verifier.
acceptance_criteria: Exported XML has a non-zero anchor count for every fretted difficulty; the item-14 tolerance check reports no missing positions on the parity fixture.
tests: Export test asserting anchors on a fixture arrangement
Tolerance check passes on exported output
items.complexity: high (EOF semantics must be traced, not invented)
items.verification: Repository preflight plus an in-game Product Reality check of one exported song.
items.definition_of_done: Merged; one real exported song shows correct hand positioning in game.

items.title: Realized measure position parity after repeat unfolding
items.addresses: Audio at bar 34 while generated material is at bar 36 (residual ~2-measure projection error, issue #431)
items.why: Official-TAB synchronization and timing diagnosis depend on agreeing with EOF's realized bar/beat.
items.consumer: Song Workspace bar/beat display and the score projection used by Arrangement Preview.
items.objective: Expose EOF's realized measure position after repeats are unfolded and resolve sparse EOF bar/beat observations to the same realized bar and beat in Song Workspace.
acceptance_criteria: Sparse EOF bar/beat observations on the parity fixture resolve to identical realized bars and beats.
tests: Differential test against the EOF parity fixture
items.verification: Repository preflight plus the parity differential.

items.title: Map corpus-dependent interfaces and the online evidence adapter contract
items.addresses: Research must not require a preloaded local corpus
items.why: Every later online-retrieval slice needs a stable provenance contract and a list of what currently assumes the corpus.
items.consumer: KEC-3 (bounded on-demand extraction) and KEA-4 (AI online-evidence adapter).
items.objective: Inventory every standard-path call that requires the local corpus or PDF warehouse and write the online evidence adapter contract: source identity, citation provenance, retrieval errors, cache and disk bounds.
acceptance_criteria: A reviewed design note lists each corpus-dependent interface with its replacement and defines the adapter's data contract.
items.definition_of_done: Contract merged as a doc; KEC-3 and KEA-4 reference it.

items.title: Bounded cache eviction policy for on-demand sources
items.roadmap_ref: docs/OWNER_APPROVED_ROADMAP_2026-10-25.md: bounded ephemeral cache, retention and cleanup policies; next slice 2
items.addresses: Bounded ephemeral cache and cleanup for streamed remote sources
items.why: On-demand retrieval must keep disk use bounded; the eviction decision is the pure core of that policy and is testable alone.
items.consumer: KEC-3's on-demand source cache calls it before every write and on cleanup.
items.objective: Add knowledge_engine/cache_eviction.py with select_cache_evictions: entries are (key, size_bytes, last_used_epoch_seconds). Return the keys to evict: first every entry with now - last_used > max_age_seconds, then least-recently-used remaining entries until the remaining total size is <= max_bytes. Order evictions by last_used ascending, ties by key ascending; expired entries come first.
acceptance_criteria: The six build examples hold exactly
Standard library only; strict mypy and ruff pass
Repository preflight passes
tests: tests/test_cache_eviction.py generated from the build examples
items.verification: Worker slice checks (pytest, mypy, ruff) and the repository's canonical preflight; CI green before merge.
items.definition_of_done: Merged; counted as product progress only once KEC-3 merges and calls it.

build.signature: def select_cache_evictions(entries: list[tuple[str, int, float]], max_bytes: int, max_age_seconds: float, now: float) -> list[str]:
build.objective: Return the cache keys to evict. entries are (key, size_bytes, last_used). First evict every entry with now - last_used > max_age_seconds, oldest first. Then evict the least recently used remaining entries until their total size is <= max_bytes. Order by last_used ascending, ties by key ascending.

examples.why: nothing is older than 60 s and 90 <= 100 bytes
a was last used 100 s ago, which is more than 60 s
180 bytes: evict least recently used a (120 left), then b (60 left <= 100)
a and b tie on last_used so key order decides; 90 -> 60 -> 30 <= 40
old is expired and comes first; then 140 bytes remain so x (least recently used) goes, leaving 70

build.note: Pure eviction policy for the bounded on-demand source cache (roadmap: bounded ephemeral cache); KEC-3 consumes it.

items.title: Bounded on-demand source extraction with cache cleanup
items.addresses: Stream/process remote sources with bounded cache, retention and cleanup; no silent deletion of user documents
items.why: This is the core online-evidence capability that replaces the mandatory local corpus.
items.consumer: Research Report v1 in knowledge-engine-ai (KEA-4) and the web flow (KEW-3).
items.objective: Implement on-demand source extraction behind the KEC-1 contract with a bounded ephemeral cache that calls select_cache_evictions (KEC-2), never touching user documents outside the cache directory.
acceptance_criteria: Tests cover citations, retrieval errors, cache cleanup and the disk limit; user documents outside the cache are never deleted.
tests: Extraction tests with a fake HTTP source
items.definition_of_done: Merged; KEC-2 becomes used product code.

items.title: Structured evidence for report-level auditability
items.addresses: Reports need structured, auditable evidence records
items.why: Source-grounded claims and verifiable citations are acceptance requirements of Research Report v1.
items.consumer: knowledge-engine-ai report synthesis and the web evidence view.
items.objective: Emit the structured evidence record #449 specifies from the evidence pipeline, with provenance for every claim.
acceptance_criteria: Every report claim links to a structured evidence record with source identity and location.
tests: Evidence record schema and round-trip tests

items.title: End-to-end online-source research without a pre-ingested corpus

items.why: This is the milestone's proof of done.
items.consumer: The owner's research workflow.
items.objective: Run one real research question end to end through core, AI and web with an empty local corpus and record the evidence.
acceptance_criteria: A real report is produced with verifiable citations, no corpus prerequisite, and the cache cleaned afterwards.
items.definition_of_done: Evidence recorded and reviewed by the owner.

items.title: Identify local-corpus and Ollama hard dependencies
items.addresses: Local Ollama must be optional, not a research prerequisite
items.why: The online-evidence adapter cannot be placed until the hard dependencies are known.
items.consumer: KEA-4's online-evidence adapter, which must be placed at the seams this audit names.
items.objective: List every orchestration path that hard-requires the local corpus or a local Ollama model and propose the seam for each.
acceptance_criteria: A reviewed list of hard dependencies with proposed seams.
items.definition_of_done: Merged as a doc referenced by KEA-4.

items.title: Resolve the two unused merged helpers (PRs #186, #187)
items.roadmap_ref: Iron God 2026-10-27 report: merged code must be used by the product
items.addresses: normalize_text (utils.py) and remove_html_tags have no callers; remove_html_tags has an open Codex P2 defect (quoted '>' and multiline tags)
items.why: Unused, partly defective code was merged by the self-planning experiment; it should be wired with a correct implementation or removed.
items.consumer: Source-text cleaning in the online-evidence path (KEA-4), or nothing (remove).
items.objective: Either replace remove_html_tags with an html.parser-based implementation that handles the Codex cases and call both helpers from the source-text path, or remove both modules and their tests.
acceptance_criteria: No unused helper remains; if kept, 'Link' yields 'Link' and multiline opening tags are removed.
tests: Codex review cases as regression tests (if kept)

items.title: Research must broaden after an indexed miss

items.objective: When indexed retrieval misses, broaden to online discovery through the existing contracts instead of terminating.
acceptance_criteria: A question with no local hits proceeds to online discovery and produces sources.
tests: Orchestration test with an empty index and a fake online provider

items.title: Online-evidence adapter and report orchestration

items.title: End-to-end single-request report test including missing and contradictory sources

acceptance_criteria: python -m mypy knowledge_engine_web tests reports no errors with the knowledge-engine-ai pin installed.
